claims.statement: MDCG 2025-10 describes PMS as a system spanning from first market placement through the intended lifetime of the last device and interacting with the quality-management system.
MDCG 2022-21 explains that MDR PSURs require systematic review of PMS data for class IIa, IIb, and III devices.

contrary_evidence: Established eQMS and regulatory platforms include complaint and PMS modules.
The official guidance explicitly preserves manufacturer accountability and does not make automated drafts sufficient.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: device-specific terminology maps and a reviewer-labelled corpus of signal classifications and evidence defects
fingerprint.customer: small EU medical-device and IVD manufacturers with limited in-house surveillance analytics
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: authorised representatives, regulatory consultancies, quality-system implementers, and testing laboratories
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: multi-source ingestion, deduplication, denominator tracking, explainable signal detection, and citation-bound draft evidence
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: the manufacturer pays a recurring device-family surveillance subscription
fingerprint.problem_trigger: a complaint, incident, literature result, corrective action, sales update, or periodic report cutoff arrives

founder_fit: Unusually strong neuroscience, health, data-science, and medical-adjacent fit; experts can be contracted while the founder builds the automation and evidence lineage.
risks: Missed signals could harm patients and expose customers and provider.
Health data and literature licensing must be handled lawfully.

structure.control_point: the reviewed signal table and traceable PMS or PSUR evidence pack maintained over the device lifetime
structure.critical_dependency: lawful access to complete complaint, vigilance, sales, literature, and device-identifier data plus qualified human sign-off

thesis: A device-family-specific workflow can continuously deduplicate complaints, vigilance events, literature, corrective actions, and sales denominators, surface explainable signals, and draft traceable PMS/PSUR evidence for accountable regulatory review. Regulatory consultancies and authorised representatives provide distribution; every new datum and reporting cycle repeats demand.
title: Post-Market Safety Signal Factory for Small Medical-Device Makers
uncertainties: Ability to obtain complete denominators and complaint feeds.
Willingness of authorised representatives to distribute rather than build.
